svg.text: AI CAsH — target application architecture (end of Tier 3)
Clawdia STP evolved into an AI harness for claim medical assessment · headless, AI-first, people only where they add value
Claim path — orchestration and system of record
Logic Apps + Functions · runs the assessment path · thresholds · pause / resume
AI never declines a claim on its own — declines go to UPM’s manual path
Quick fix bays on the Claim Visualiser
answers bay · AI-assisted manual medical assessment
release when UPM asks · write assessment
Vet submits; VetHub publishes business events — no polling.
Events start the claim in COS and the assessment in parallel.
The harness enriches the claim context and asks the ML ensemble.
Not confident: SQL, ML and AI agent answer the clinical questions; only
what needs a person becomes a quick fix task.
The assessor confirms or answers in a bay; automation resumes and predicts
the diagnosis — still low → AI-assisted manual assessment.
UPM asks for the result; the harness writes it through Dynamic CLAPI.
CLAPI · VetHub → COS poller · Dynamic CLAPI lodge · CATCH / CATCH2
MSMQ logging · COS and VetHub Windows services · COS.API IIS sites
Go Tech VMs on the claim path · manual service-provider dual insert
